context: Sho-young writes thank-you cards for father's day to Daichi.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、父の日、カード書いた!
lines.en: Mom — I wrote a Father's Day card!
lines.style: Bright, unbottled excitement. Quick pickup on the announcement. Warm pride in the accomplishment. Slight eagerness for approval in the rising cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: That's wonderful — let me see it!
lines.style: Soft delight, genuine interest. Lean in slightly. Warm maternal tone without performing the role. The kind of attentiveness that makes a child feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 感謝、いっぱい書いたよ。
lines.en: I wrote lots of thank yous in it.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Small chest-puff of pride in his own work. Steady, deliberate pace — each word matters. Waiting for her to understand what he's done.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Your dad is going to be so happy about this.
lines.style: Warm reassurance, grounded conviction. Soft but steady. Not overpromising — stating what she knows to be true. The kind of certainty a child needs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright anticipation, almost bouncing with it. Quick tempo. The joy of a countdown. Simple, genuine, not performed.
